items.title: Ringu
items.creator: Hideo Nakata
items.description: When her niece is found dead along with three friends after viewing a supposedly cursed videotape, reporter Reiko sets out to investigate. She finds the tape, watches it and receives a phone call informing her that she'll die in a...

items.title: Train to Busan
items.creator: Yeon Sang-ho
items.description: While a zombie virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan.

items.title: Let the Right One In
items.creator: Tomas Alfredson
items.description: A bullied boy forms a unique friendship with his new neighbor, a peculiar girl with a dark secret.

items.title: REC
items.creator: Jaume Balagueró, Paco Plaza
items.description: A television reporter follows firefighters into an apartment building that is suddenly sealed off.

items.title: The Wailing
items.creator: Na Hong-jin
items.description: A rural police officer seeks an explanation for violent illness spreading through his village.

items.title: Audition
items.creator: Takashi Miike
items.description: A widower has his film producer friend organize a fake audition as a means of helping him find a new girlfriend, but the woman he selects is not who she appears to be.

items.title: Suspiria
items.creator: Dario Argento
items.description: An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.

items.title: Tigers Are Not Afraid
items.creator: Issa López
items.description: Children orphaned by cartel violence navigate a city where their wishes and the dead refuse to stay quiet.

items.title: Saloum
items.creator: Jean Luc Herbulot
items.description: Mercenaries hiding in a remote Senegalese resort discover that one of them has brought a dangerous past along.

items.title: Ju-on: The Grudge
items.creator: Takashi Shimizu
items.description: A mysterious and vengeful spirit marks and pursues anybody who dares enter the house in which it resides.

items.title: Shutter
items.creator: Banjong Pisanthanakun, Parkpoom Wongpoom
items.description: When Jane and Tun run over a girl in a car accident, they speed away immediately from the crime scene. However, Tun, a photographer, soon discovers strange shadows in his photos, which unsettles them.

items.title: The Devil's Backbone
items.creator: Guillermo del Toro
items.description: After Carlos - a 12-year-old whose father has died in the Spanish Civil War - arrives at an ominous boys' orphanage, he discovers the school is haunted and has many dark secrets which he must uncover.

items.title: A Tale of Two Sisters
items.creator: Kim Jee-woon
items.description: After being institutionalized in a mental hospital, Su-mi reunites with her sister, Su-yeon, and they return to live at their country home. But strange events plague the house, leading to surprising revelations and a shocking conc...

items.title: Cure
items.creator: Kiyoshi Kurosawa
items.description: A frustrated detective deals with the case of several gruesome murders committed by people who have no recollection of what they've done.

items.title: Raw
items.creator: Julia Ducournau
items.description: A vegetarian veterinary student develops an unsettling appetite after a hazing ritual.

items.title: Impetigore
items.creator: Joko Anwar
items.description: A woman returns to her ancestral village and discovers that her inheritance is tied to a deadly curse.

items.title: Incantation
items.creator: Kevin Ko
items.description: A mother records her efforts to protect her daughter from a curse she helped unleash.

items.title: When Evil Lurks
items.creator: Demián Rugna
items.description: In a remote village, two brothers find a demon-infected man just about to "give birth" to evil itself. They decide to get rid of the body, only to end up unintentionally spreading chaos.

items.title: The Orphanage
items.creator: J.A. Bayona
items.description: A woman brings her family back to her childhood home, which used to be an orphanage for handicapped children. Before long, her son starts to communicate with an invisible new friend.

items.title: Dark Water
items.creator: Hideo Nakata
items.description: A mother and daughter move into an apartment where a spreading leak conceals a haunting.

items.title: Thirst
items.creator: Park Chan-wook
items.description: Through a failed medical experiment, a priest is stricken with vampirism and is forced to abandon his ascetic ways.

items.title: Satan's Slaves
items.creator: Joko Anwar
items.description: After their mother dies, a family begins to suspect that her presence has returned with a terrible purpose.

items.title: Dumplings
items.creator: Fruit Chan
items.description: A former television star seeks rejuvenation from a cook whose secret recipe demands increasingly disturbing ingredients.

items.title: Goodnight Mommy
items.creator: Severin Fiala, Veronika Franz
items.description: Twin boys move to a new house with their mother after she has face-changing cosmetic surgery, but under the bandages is someone the boys don't recognize.

items.title: La Llorona
items.creator: Jayro Bustamante
items.description: A disgraced Guatemalan general hears a woman crying as his household confronts the past he tried to bury.

items.title: The Host
items.creator: Bong Joon Ho
items.description: A monster emerges from Seoul's Han River and begins attacking people. One victim's loving family does what it can to rescue her from its clutches.

items.title: The Eye
items.creator: Danny Pang, Oxide Chun Pang
items.description: A corneal transplant restores a woman's sight but leaves her seeing things that others cannot.
items.country: Hong Kong, Singapore, Thailand, United Kingdom, Netherlands

items.title: Pulse
items.creator: Kiyoshi Kurosawa
items.description: Two groups of people discover evidence that suggests spirits may be trying to invade the human world through the Internet.

items.title: The Medium
items.creator: Banjong Pisanthanakun
items.description: A documentary crew follows a Thai shaman as her niece develops troubling symptoms.

items.title: Gonjiam: Haunted Asylum
items.creator: Jung Bum-shik
items.description: A livestream crew enters an abandoned psychiatric hospital in search of an audience.

items.title: Noroi: The Curse
items.creator: Kôji Shiraishi
items.description: A filmmaker follows scattered paranormal incidents toward a disturbing common explanation.

items.title: The Queen of Black Magic
items.creator: Kimo Stamboel
items.description: A return to a childhood orphanage awakens a supernatural reckoning with its buried secrets.

items.title: Terrified
items.creator: Demián Rugna
items.description: When strange events occur in a neighborhood in Buenos Aires, a doctor specializing in the paranormal, her colleague, and an ex police officer decide to investigate further.

items.title: Deep Red
items.creator: Dario Argento
items.description: After witnessing a murder, a musician follows a trail of clues that draws him closer to the killer.

items.title: Martyrs
items.creator: Pascal Laugier
items.description: A young woman's quest for revenge against the people who kidnapped and tormented her as a child leads her and a friend, who is also a victim of child abuse, on a terrifying journey into a living hell of depravity.

items.title: Inside
items.creator: Alexandre Bustillo, Julien Maury
items.description: Four months after the death of her husband, a woman on the brink of motherhood is tormented in her home by a strange woman who wants her unborn baby.

items.title: Baskin
items.creator: Can Evrenol
items.description: Police answering a call at an abandoned building enter a nightmare beneath the ordinary world.

items.title: Huesera: The Bone Woman
items.creator: Michelle Garza Cervera
items.description: A pregnant woman encounters a threatening presence as the life she thought she wanted begins to fracture.

items.title: Atlantics
items.creator: Mati Diop
items.description: After workers leave Dakar by sea, a young woman finds that their absence has taken an uncanny form.

items.title: Gaia
items.creator: Jaco Bouwer
items.description: An injured ranger takes shelter with forest dwellers whose beliefs are tied to a changing natural world.

items.title: The Soul Collector
items.creator: Harold Holscher
items.description: A family moving to an inherited farm takes in a stranger burdened by a supernatural debt.

items.title: Viy
items.creator: Konstantin Ershov, Georgiy Kropachyov, Aleksandr Ptushko
items.description: A student must spend three nights keeping vigil over a young woman's body.

items.title: Witchhammer
items.creator: Otakar Vávra
items.description: A witchcraft trial becomes a tool for ambition and persecution in seventeenth-century Moravia.

items.title: One Cut of the Dead
items.creator: Shin'ichirô Ueda
items.description: Things go badly for a hack director and film crew shooting a low budget zombie movie in an abandoned WWII Japanese facility, when they are attacked by real zombies.

items.title: Detention
items.creator: John Hsu
items.description: Students trapped in a transformed school confront ghosts shaped by repression and betrayal.

items.title: Climax
items.creator: Gaspar Noé
items.description: French dancers gather in a remote, empty school building to rehearse on a wintry night. The all-night celebration morphs into a hallucinatory nightmare when they learn their sangria is laced with LSD.

items.title: Cronos
items.creator: Guillermo del Toro
items.description: An antique dealer discovers a mechanical device that restores youth while awakening a thirst for blood.

items.title: Good Manners
items.creator: Marco Dutra, Juliana Rojas
items.description: A caregiver's bond with her pregnant employer leads to an unexpected child and a dangerous responsibility.

items.title: Titane
items.creator: Julia Ducournau
items.description: A woman on the run assumes a missing person's identity as her body undergoes impossible changes.

items.title: I Saw the Devil
items.creator: Kim Jee-woon
items.description: A secret agent exacts revenge on a serial killer through a series of captures and releases.

sources.title: The best Japanese films: one per year
sources.basis: The 1997–1999 entries identify Cure, Ring and Audition within Japanese cinema and discuss their horror traditions. Ringu is the existing catalog title for Ring.

sources.title: 10 great South Korean horror films
sources.basis: BFI discusses these films as South Korean horror, including Train to Busan in the introduction.

sources.title: 10 great supernatural horror films of the 21st century
sources.basis: The article distinguishes the Japanese originals from their American remakes and selects the Spanish-language and Senegalese-set ghost stories. Atlantics is a supernatural drama rather than a conventional scare film.

sources.title: 10 great Swedish films
sources.basis: The entry identifies Tomas Alfredson's Swedish vampire film, not its American remake.

sources.title: 10 great European horror films
sources.basis: BFI places Dario Argento's 1977 original in the Italian horror tradition.

sources.title: 10 great Mexican horror films
sources.basis: These selections appear in BFI's account of Mexican horror; Cronos is discussed in the introduction. Countries of co-production are separately retained in metadata.

sources.title: Saloum
sources.basis: The exhibitor lists Senegal, French and Wolof, and director Jean Luc Herbulot. This supports an African production selection rather than inferring origin from setting alone.

sources.title: 10 great modern south-east Asian films
sources.basis: BFI explicitly places the 2004 film in Thailand's horror cinema and names both directors.

sources.title: The Devil's Backbone
sources.basis: The director-approved edition lists Mexico and Spain, Spanish language, and 2001. The film is not classified from its Spanish setting alone.

sources.title: 10 great French horror films
sources.basis: BFI selects these films as French horror and discusses New French Extremity. The original 2007 Inside and 2008 Martyrs are used.

sources.title: Impetigore
sources.basis: Official distributor identifies Joko Anwar, Indonesian language and the ancestral-village curse. This legacy page supports film identity, not current availability.

sources.title: When Evil Lurks
sources.basis: The exhibitor lists Argentina and USA, Spanish language, and Argentine director Demian Rugna. The US co-production credit is preserved.

sources.title: Satan's Slaves
sources.basis: Official distributor identifies Joko Anwar's 2017 Indonesian-language film. This is not the 1980 film or its 2022 sequel.

sources.title: 10 great films set in Hong Kong
sources.basis: BFI identifies Fruit Chan's 2004 standalone feature, expanded from Three... Extremes, and examines its Hong Kong social context. Country is also present in saved metadata.

sources.title: Goodnight Mommy official pressbook
sources.basis: Production pressbook lists Austria, 2014 and directors Veronika Franz and Severin Fiala, distinguishing the original from the American remake.

sources.title: La Llorona
sources.basis: Criterion identifies Guatemala and Jayro Bustamante's 2019 political folk horror, not the unrelated US studio film.

sources.title: 10 great modern South Korean films
sources.basis: BFI identifies Bong Joon-ho's 2006 Korean monster film.

sources.title: Arrow Video Channel May new releases
sources.basis: The distributor identifies the Pang brothers' 2002 Hong Kong horror original and its corneal-transplant premise. The dated program is not used as a current availability claim.

sources.title: Lost souls: faith and the occult in the Cult strand
sources.basis: Festival curation identifies the Thai shamanism mock documentary, directed by Banjong Pisanthanakun and produced with Na Hong-jin.

sources.title: The Queen of Black Magic
sources.basis: Distributor synopsis identifies Kimo Stamboel's Indonesian orphanage-revenge film. Its release label is 2020; saved movie metadata uses original 2019. No service availability is inferred.

sources.title: Terrified
sources.basis: Distributor synopsis identifies Demian Rugna's Buenos Aires horror. Its 2018 release label differs from the saved 2017 original-release metadata.

sources.title: Baskin (2015)
sources.basis: BFI lists Turkey and USA and director Can Evrenol. Country credits vary by source: Cinemeta lists Turkey only; BFI's co-production information is preserved in this note.

sources.title: Baskin
sources.basis: The exhibitor lists Turkish language and Turkey and describes the supernatural police-raid premise.

sources.title: Huesera: 2022 program
sources.basis: The world-premiere program explicitly lists Mexico and Peru, Spanish language and the horror category.

sources.title: Atlantique by Mati Diop
sources.basis: Cannes discusses French-Senegalese filmmaker Mati Diop and her Wolof-language Dakar story. Saved metadata retains its France/Senegal/Belgium production credits.

sources.title: 2021 Film Festival slate
sources.basis: The official Midnighters slate lists Gaia as South Africa, directed by Jaco Bouwer, and describes its forest-based supernatural threat.

sources.title: 2019 schedule and film guide
sources.basis: The world-premiere listing identifies 8 as South African folkloric horror directed by Harold Holscher. The Soul Collector is the alternate distribution title.

sources.title: 2019 After Dark program
sources.basis: The festival identifies 8: A South African Horror Story and the inherited-farm/Lazarus premise, corroborating the alternate title and origin.

sources.title: 10 great films about making a horror film
sources.basis: BFI identifies Shinichiro Ueda's 2017 zombie-film production comedy, included as a lighter horror selection.

sources.title: Detention
sources.basis: The distributor explicitly lists Taiwan, 2019 and John Hsu's school-set White Terror ghost story.

sources.title: Climax (2018)
sources.basis: BFI lists France and Belgium and Gaspar Noe. Its inclusion follows the existing horror catalog and saved metadata genres.

sources.title: Cronos
sources.basis: The director-approved edition lists Mexico, Spanish and 1993. This primary release reference is used for the displayed year; Cinemeta and BFI use 1992.

sources.title: 10 great Brazilian horror films
sources.basis: BFI identifies Marco Dutra and Juliana Rojas's 2017 film within Brazilian horror. Additional co-production countries are retained from metadata.

sources.title: Off the shelf: Korean Cinema Fan Club
sources.basis: The Korean-cinema essay discusses Kim Jee-woon's 2010 revenge thriller. It is included at horror's thriller boundary.

sources.title: Where to begin with giallo
sources.basis: Chris Gallant traces the Italian murder-mystery tradition and identifies these films within it. Genre boundaries are treated as flexible.

sources.title: All the Haunts Be Ours: A Compendium of Folk Horror, Volume One
sources.basis: All three appear in the distributor's folk-horror collection curated by Kier-La Janisse. This is curatorial evidence, not a current streaming claim.

sources.title: 10 great body horror films
sources.basis: Matthew Thrift selects these films for bodily mutation and transformation. The Fly entry discusses its practical effects.

sources.title: 10 great found-footage films
sources.basis: Billie Walker includes these examples, covering mock broadcasts, documentary forms and recovered recordings.
